notes.title: Game is released!
notes.notes:
Dear friends!

We are glad to inform you that the release of the game took place!
Now you can join the world of unique sports competitions on trucks. Only in the USSR (Russia) are organized similar competitions on 7-liter monsters.

Join our project - we will try to make it interesting!
Work on the game continues - will be added new game modes, new trucks, new routes, will significantly improve the physics of cars.
